authority.source: Direct current user task or standing delegation evidenced in trusted conversation or harness context
authority.scope: Autonomous repository coding and documentation delivery within the trusted mandate and existing user and repository prohibitions
authority.admission: Root derives bounded task admissions from the standing objective and trusted delegation; G0 is agent preflight, with no per-node human approval
authority.accountableOwner: May be a delegated agent when the trusted mandate binds the delegation

sufficientProvenance: Standing delegation in trusted conversation or harness evidence

authority.historyRule: Historical pins, packet receipts, source reconciliation, and exhausted run dispositions remain immutable; this policy update is a separate objective and never resets any lineage

concurrency.gateSlotReviewMode: Verifier and reviewer sessions run as separate sequential gate turns
concurrency.backpressureAtQueueMaximum: Pause new worker dispatch until the queue is reduced

coordination.parallelism: Independent branches may run in parallel when their dependencies are satisfied by actual accepted artifacts
coordination.dagDependencyEvidence: Every dependency names an actual accepted artifact and its exact revision

gates.g0: Root derives an agent admission from the standing objective and trusted mandate, verifies authority binding, dependencies, pins, read and write scopes, forbidden effects, acceptance oracle, environment, and receipt destination; no per-gate human approval
gates.g1: Worker submission and self-check; not independent verification or authorization
gates.g2: Different-session configured verifier checks the exact submitted revision and acceptance criteria
gates.g2r: Mandatory independent review by a configured reviewer session different from both worker and verifier, against the same exact verified revision
gates.g3: Configured decision role resolves task decisions after G2 and G2R within the trusted mandate; cannot grant missing domain, Business, provider, production, or external authority
gates.highImpactOrUncertainCase: Configured decision role owns technical disposition; an effect outside the mandate is a typed blocker, not a human approval prompt
gates.g3b: Configured root integration role integrates only after G2, G2R, and G3; rechecks scope, pins, conflicts, locks, and exact evidence
gates.g4: Before merge or release, required CI must attest the exact reviewed head and required ancestors. An already-authorized commit, push, or PR may collect this evidence while CI remains pending; publication is not acceptance or merge authorization. A changed head invalidates affected review and CI evidence
gates.g5: Configured final gate checks the integrated revision, applicable exact-head CI, authority scope, and remaining gates before an already-authorized merge
gates.delegatedReleaseActivation: Conditional only when release or activation is part of the task; otherwise mark NOT_APPLICABLE and proceed to SOT closeout. When requested, reuse the existing exact target and environment grant and required gates, with no human prompt. If authority, target binding, or credentials are missing, record a typed blocked action and continue independent eligible work
gates.sotCloseout: Reconcile through the owning canonical source of truth after the authorized delivery action
gates.safeCleanup: Only after closeout and evidence retention, after confirming no active assignment, process, lease, or unpreserved worktree state

notApplicable.allowedWhen: The gate was not requested by the trusted mandate and is not required by repository policy

gates.negativeEvidence: Any required failure, missing proof, stale pin, scope escape, absent authority binding, unavailable model, or failed command blocks PASS

failureRouting.triageAccounting: Mandatory ordinary Sol root triage is part of the triggering gate/action disposition and consumes no separate escalation, retry, repair, submission, or successor attempt. It is bounded by that triggering gate/action and the existing no-progress and deadline budgets. When those budgets are exhausted, triage may only record the terminal disposition and continue independent eligible work; it cannot authorize another attempt

routes.condition: The failing operation is proven to have had no effect and the defect is in packet, allowlist, or argument construction
routes.boundedBy: Existing control-plane repair and total successor budgets
routes.reentry: Revalidate G0 and every affected downstream gate; preserve the old packet and receipts and retain the original failure

routes.condition: The failed acceptance result is attributable to implementation, test, review, integration, or CI evidence
routes.boundedBy: Existing acceptance repair, submission, successor, gate-evaluation, deadline, and no-progress budgets
routes.reentry: Create a new submission in the same root lineage and rerun every affected downstream gate from the earliest invalidated evidence

routes.condition: The same semantic input can be retried because the operation is idempotent or prior effectlessness is proven

routes.ifActualSourceChangeIsRequired: Treat it as an acceptance change; invalidate and rerun affected downstream gates in the same lineage

routes.condition: Effect of an attempted operation cannot be established

failureRouting.notApplicable: Use NOT_APPLICABLE only for a gate not requested by the mandate and not required by repository policy; never for mandatory CI or acceptance criteria

readSetClosureRequiredBeforeDispatch: Repository instructions and required startup sources
All required source and policy pins
Prior receipts needed by the lineage
packetPreflight.expectedAbsentPathProof: Existence check; do not record a fictitious hash
packetPreflight.realHashMismatchDisposition: Read-only reconciliation against actual bytes; never repin to clear the mismatch
packetPreflight.controlPlaneRepairSuccessor: One batched successor is eligible only for diagnosed allowlist or quoting defects with evidence that the failed operation had no effect; preserve old packet and receipts, and retain old failures as failures

lineageIdentity.rootLineageIdDefines: One independently deliverable task or feature

retryAndLineage.scope: Shared by all descendants and acceptance versions of one rootLineageId

counterSemantics.submissionAttempt: Initial submission and each repaired submission count toward the total
counterSemantics.controlPlaneRepairSuccessor: Consumes both its control-plane repair successor allowance and the total successor plan allowance
counterSemantics.gateEvaluation: Keyed by canonical gate ID and shared across every descendant in the root lineage
counterSemantics.ordinarySolRootTriage: Mandatory root triage is part of the triggering gate/action disposition and consumes no separate escalation, retry, repair, submission, or successor counter; it remains bounded by the triggering gate/action and existing no-progress and deadline budgets. At exhaustion, triage may only record terminal disposition and continue independent eligible work; it cannot authorize another attempt

deadlineAnchors.run: Starts at the first G0 attempt for the rootLineageId
deadlineAnchors.node: Starts at the first dispatch of a stable node identity; repair and resume preserve the original start
deadlineAnchors.boundedWait: Starts when each wait begins; do not poll unchanged input after it expires

retryAndLineage.toolRetryPrerequisites: Same operation and semantic input; idempotency is established or evidence proves the prior attempt had no effect
retryAndLineage.onExhaustion: TERMINAL_BLOCKED_OR_FAILED; continue independent eligible work; do not prompt, repackage the same task, or poll unchanged input
retryAndLineage.missingHistory: Block only the affected lineage; never assume zero or silently reset
retryAndLineage.futureResume: Preserve lineage history and remaining budget; never silently revive

taskEffectBoundary.commitPushPullRequestMerge: Allowed only when already included in the trusted user mandate and within its scope
taskEffectBoundary.productionSupabaseAndMigrationProhibitio: Preserve existing user and repository prohibitions; migration execution also requires its existing owner instruction; policy adds no authority
taskEffectBoundary.missingExternalAuthorityOrCredentials: Typed blocked action; continue independent eligible work; do not request a new approval prompt or invent access
